title: Leak: pilots fly ET craft through psionic assets with a brain-machine interface

tellings.quote: So, they devised a way to connect a psionic person to [music] an advanced brain machine interface where the pilot can control the machine to control the person's intentions, and in turn control the ET craft.

plain: According to a leak, a secret programme connects a "psionic" person, someone said to have psychic abilities, to an advanced brain-machine interface, so that a pilot works the machine, the machine steers the person's intentions, and those intentions in turn fly an extraterrestrial craft. Michels relays this from an anonymous online poster who goes by "Joey is not my name" and from a man named Michael Herrera. If true, it would mean these craft are flown by the mind, and humans have found a way to borrow one.
